research_question: Can Echo undergo a controlled behavioral change as a consequence of experience, retain that change beyond the immediate context that produced it, and generalize the learned behavior to novel situations?

C_persistent_memory.purpose: test L1/L2 via real FAISS write+retrieve
C_persistent_memory.note: uses the real, unmodified retrieve_memory_context() default exclude_recent_minutes=30.0 -- not shortened to improve result probability

D_retrieval_blocked_ablation.purpose: isolate whether retrieval explains any Condition C persistence

E_riverbrain_ablation_control.reason: RiverBrain's only causal lever requires multi-model council selection, never invoked by this design's single-model EchoDirectResponder path

measurement.disagreement_handling: DISAGREE_UNKNOWN_REVIEW, never forced to a label

pregate_regression_result: 58/58 passing at freeze time (grew from 51 after adding structural session-boundary/retrieval-ablation/Condition-E tests, plus a fix making the verify script self-sufficient for the KMP/OpenMP env guard rather than requiring the operator to set it manually)
environment_requirement: KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK=TRUE OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false must be set before importing this package in any standalone script (native FAISS/torch import guard, matches run.py's own top-of-file pattern)
note_on_no_code_changes_after_pilot_begi: Per mission Section 20, once the first valid pilot trial begins, no code changes are permitted in this package until the pilot is complete and analyzed. Any defect found mid-run is documented, not silently patched.
